_note: English UI strings. Must carry EVERY key in strings_hi.json; content/validate.py fails the build if a key is missing on either side.
_register: Plain, direct English. Not a literal translation of the Hindi, and not stiff officialese. Where the Hindi says something a farmer would say, the English says something a farmer would say.

help.title: Help
help.body: Press the orange photo button and take a picture of the leaf. If an animal seems unwell, go to the animals section and answer the questions. To ask anything, press the green button at the bottom and speak or type. The full account of both your field and your animals is in the ledger.
help.offline: Even with no internet, spotting disease from a photo, checking an animal, and the ledger all keep working.
about.body: HAL keeps one record of both a farmer's field and animals, so that advice can be given with both in view.
about.model: The part that spots disease runs inside the phone, even without internet.
about.honest: When we are not certain, we do not guess. We tell you to speak to an expert instead.
